notes.title: Hello World!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I'm very excited to finally have my very own game on steam! The first of its kind! This has been a dream in the making, and I can't believe the day is almost here when I get to share my creation with all of you.

It's been a journey of ups and downs, but my passion for game development keeps me going. I am really so excited to get this game finished and it is slowly but surely getting there (no thanks to my procrastination).

As this is my first game I am not deluded into thinking it will be perfect, once the game is out I am going to love hearing about everyone's thoughts. All the support means a lot, adding my game to your wishlist on Steam, sharing the news with your friends, really helps reach more players!

I'll keep you posted on the release date, and I might also make a trailer before the release but no promises!
